units.locator: Article 28. Personnel Work in a Municipality
units.text: 8) conducting competitions to fill vacant municipal service positions and including municipal servants in the personnel reserve;
units.label: Point 8 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Personnel Work in a Municipality
units.text: 9) conducting appraisals of municipal servants;
units.label: Point 9 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Personnel Work in a Municipality
units.text: 10) organizing work with the personnel reserve and ensuring its effective use;
units.label: Point 10 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Personnel Work in a Municipality
units.text: 11) organizing and conducting verification of information submitted by a citizen upon entry into municipal service and during the municipal servant’s period of service;
units.label: Point 11 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Personnel Work in a Municipality
units.text: 11.1) arranging clearance of the prescribed form to information constituting a state secret;
units.label: Point 11.1 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Personnel Work in a Municipality
units.text: 12) organizing verification of information on municipal servants’ income, property and property-related obligations and their compliance with restrictions related to municipal service established by Article 13 of this Federal Law and other federal laws;
units.label: Point 12 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Personnel Work in a Municipality
units.text: 13) advising municipal servants on legal and other matters of municipal service;
units.label: Point 13 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Personnel Work in a Municipality
units.text: 14) addressing other personnel matters determined by labor legislation and a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 14 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28.1. Training Personnel for Municipal Service on a Contractual Basis
units.text: Article 28.1. Training Personnel for Municipal Service on a Contractual Basis
units.label: Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Training Personnel for Municipal Service on a Contractual Basis
units.text: 1. To develop a highly qualified municipal service workforce, local self-government bodies may organize the training of citizens for municipal service on a contractual basis in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on education and taking account of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Training Personnel for Municipal Service on a Contractual Basis
units.text: 2. An agreement on targeted education with an obligation of subsequent municipal service (hereinafter referred to as a targeted education agreement) is concluded between a local self-government body and a citizen and provides for the citizen’s obligation to serve in municipal service in that body for a specified period after completing education.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Training Personnel for Municipal Service on a Contractual Basis
units.text: 3. A targeted education agreement is concluded on a competitive basis according to the procedure established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation. Information on the competition for conclusion of a targeted education agreement must be published in the print media outlet used for official publication of municipal legal acts and posted on the official website of the local self-government body on the Internet information and telecommunications network at least one month before the competition.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Training Personnel for Municipal Service on a Contractual Basis
units.text: 4. Citizens who have command of the state language of the Russian Federation, are receiving professional education at the corresponding level for the first time, and have no obligations under an apprenticeship or other agreement giving rise to employment relations after completion of education are entitled to participate in the competition for conclusion of a targeted education agreement. A citizen participating in the competition must, upon entry into municipal service and throughout the period provided for by part 5 of this Article, meet the requirements established by this Federal Law for filling municipal service positions.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Training Personnel for Municipal Service on a Contractual Basis
units.text: 5. The compulsory period of municipal service after completion of targeted education is established by the targeted education agreement. That period may not be shorter than the period during which the local self-government body provided social support measures to the citizen under the targeted education agreement, but may not exceed five years.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Training Personnel for Municipal Service on a Contractual Basis
units.text: 6. The obligations and liability of the parties to a targeted education agreement are established by that agreement in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Training Personnel for Municipal Service on a Contractual Basis
units.text: 7. A targeted education agreement may be concluded with a citizen only once.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 28.1. Training Personnel for Municipal Service on a Contractual Basis
units.text: 8. Expenditure provided for by a targeted education agreement is financed from the local budget.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 28.1

units.locator: Article 29. Personal Data of a Municipal Servant
units.text: Article 29. Personal Data of a Municipal Servant
units.label: Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Personal Data of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 1. A municipal servant’s personal data means information concerning an individual municipal servant that the employer’s representative (employer) requires in connection with that servant’s performance of the duties of the municipal service position held.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Personal Data of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 2. A municipal servant’s personal data shall be processed in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data, subject to the special provisions of Chapter 14 of the Labor Code of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 30. Procedure for Maintaining a Municipal Servant’s Personal File
units.text: Article 30. Procedure for Maintaining a Municipal Servant’s Personal File
units.label: Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Procedure for Maintaining a Municipal Servant’s Personal File
units.text: 1. A personal file is opened for a municipal servant, to which documents connected with entry into municipal service, its performance and dismissal from municipal service are added.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Procedure for Maintaining a Municipal Servant’s Personal File
units.text: 2. A municipal servant’s personal file is retained for 10 years. Upon the servant’s departure from municipal service, the personal file is stored in the archives of the local self-government body at the servant’s last place of municipal service.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Procedure for Maintaining a Municipal Servant’s Personal File
units.text: 3. If the local self-government body in which the municipal servant held a municipal service position is dissolved, the personal file is transferred for safekeeping to the local self-government body to which the dissolved body’s functions have been transferred, or to its legal successor.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Procedure for Maintaining a Municipal Servant’s Personal File
units.text: 4. A municipal servant’s personal file is maintained according to the procedure established for maintaining a state civil servant’s personal file.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 31. Register of Municipal Servants in a Municipality
units.text: Article 31. Register of Municipal Servants in a Municipality
units.label: Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Register of Municipal Servants in a Municipality
units.text: 1. A register of municipal servants is maintained in a municipality.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Register of Municipal Servants in a Municipality
units.text: 2. A municipal servant who leaves municipal service is removed from the register of municipal servants on the day of departure.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Register of Municipal Servants in a Municipality
units.text: 3. If a municipal servant dies (is killed), or is recognized as missing or declared dead by a court decision that has entered into legal force, the servant is removed from the register of municipal servants on the day following death (being killed) or the entry into legal force of the court decision.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 31. Register of Municipal Servants in a Municipality
units.text: 4. The procedure for maintaining the register of municipal servants is approved by a municipal legal act.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 31

units.locator: Article 32. Priority Areas for Developing the Municipal Service Workforce
units.text: Article 32. Priority Areas for Developing the Municipal Service Workforce
units.label: Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Priority Areas for Developing the Municipal Service Workforce
units.text: The priority areas for developing the municipal service workforce are:
units.label: Art. 32 · “The priority areas for developing the municipal service…”

units.locator: Article 32. Priority Areas for Developing the Municipal Service Workforce
units.text: 1) appointing highly qualified specialists to municipal service positions with due regard to their professional qualities and competence;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Priority Areas for Developing the Municipal Service Workforce
units.text: 2) facilitating the career advancement of municipal servants;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Priority Areas for Developing the Municipal Service Workforce
units.text: 3) training personnel for municipal service and providing additional professional education for municipal servants;
units.label: Point 3 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Priority Areas for Developing the Municipal Service Workforce
units.text: 4) creating a personnel reserve and using it effectively;
units.label: Point 4 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Priority Areas for Developing the Municipal Service Workforce
units.text: 5) assessing municipal servants’ work results through appraisal;
units.label: Point 5 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 32. Priority Areas for Developing the Municipal Service Workforce
units.text: 6) applying modern personnel selection technologies when citizens enter municipal service and modern personnel management technologies during their service.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 33. Personnel Reserve in Municipal Service
units.text: Article 33. Personnel Reserve in Municipal Service
units.label: Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Personnel Reserve in Municipal Service
units.text: Municipalities may establish a personnel reserve for filling vacant municipal service positions in accordance with municipal legal acts.
units.label: Art. 33 · text

units.locator: Chapter 9. FUNDING AND DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMS FOR MUNICIPAL SERVICE
units.text: Chapter 9. FUNDING AND DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMS FOR MUNICIPAL SERVICE
units.label: Chapter 9. FUNDING AND DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMS FOR MUNICIPAL SERVICE

units.locator: Article 34. Funding of Municipal Service
units.text: Article 34. Funding of Municipal Service
units.label: Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Funding of Municipal Service
units.text: Municipal service is financed from local budgets.
units.label: Art. 34 · text

units.locator: Article 35. Municipal Service Development Programs
units.text: Article 35. Municipal Service Development Programs
units.label: Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Municipal Service Development Programs
units.text: 1. The development of municipal service is supported by municipal programs for the development of municipal service and municipal service development programs of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, financed, respectively, from local budgets and the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Municipal Service Development Programs
units.text: 2. Experiments may be conducted in individual local self-government bodies to improve the effectiveness of those bodies and municipal servants. The procedure, conditions and time limits for experiments during implementation of the municipal service development programs specified in part 1 of this Article are established by normative legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and municipal legal acts.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 36. Repeal of Certain Legislative Acts (Provisions of Legislative Acts) of the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 36. Repeal of Certain Legislative Acts (Provisions of Legislative Acts) of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 36

units.locator: Article 36. Repeal of Certain Legislative Acts (Provisions of Legislative Acts) of the Russian Federation
units.text: The following are repealed from the date this Federal Law enters into force:
units.label: Art. 36 · “The following are repealed from the date this Federal Law…”

units.locator: Article 36. Repeal of Certain Legislative Acts (Provisions of Legislative Acts) of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1) Federal Law No. 8-ФЗ of 8 January 1998 ‘On the Foundations of Municipal Service in the Russian Federation’ (Collected Legislation of the Russian Federation, 1998, No. 2, Article 224);
units.label: Point 1 Art. 36

units.locator: Article 36. Repeal of Certain Legislative Acts (Provisions of Legislative Acts) of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2) Federal Law No. 75-ФЗ of 13 April 1999 ‘On Amendments and Additions to the Federal Law “On the Foundations of Municipal Service in the Russian Federation”’ (Collected Legislation of the Russian Federation, 1999, No. 16, Article 1933);
units.label: Point 2 Art. 36

units.locator: Article 36. Repeal of Certain Legislative Acts (Provisions of Legislative Acts) of the Russian Federation
units.text: 3) Federal Law No. 38-ФЗ of 19 April 2002 ‘On an Addition to Article 8 of the Federal Law “On the Foundations of Municipal Service in the Russian Federation”’ (Collected Legislation of the Russian Federation, 2002, No. 16, Article 1499);
units.label: Point 3 Art. 36

units.locator: Article 36. Repeal of Certain Legislative Acts (Provisions of Legislative Acts) of the Russian Federation
units.text: 4) point 13 of Article 1 of Federal Law No. 112-ФЗ of 25 July 2002 ‘On Amendments and Additions to Legislative Acts of the Russian Federation in Connection with the Adoption of the Federal Law “On Combating Extremist Activity”’ (Collected Legislation of the Russian Federation, 2002, No. 30, Article 3029).
units.label: Point 4 Art. 36

units.locator: Article 37. Application of Laws and Other Normative Legal Acts on Municipal Service in Connection with the Entry into Force of This Federal Law
units.text: Article 37. Application of Laws and Other Normative Legal Acts on Municipal Service in Connection with the Entry into Force of This Federal Law
units.label: Art. 37

units.locator: Article 37. Application of Laws and Other Normative Legal Acts on Municipal Service in Connection with the Entry into Force of This Federal Law
units.text: Until federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, and laws and other normative legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation on municipal service, are brought into conformity with this Federal Law, those federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation and laws and other normative legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation on municipal service apply insofar as they do not conflict with this Federal Law.
units.label: Art. 37 · text
